2048 AI Player

  • I made an AI that plays 2048!!!
  • i'm obsessed with 2048! and i want to learn about machine learning! natural solution? combine the two!
  • problem: i'm a stupid little undergrad with a smooth little brain and do not know much about neural networks
  • thought process: i want to use imitation learning, since playing random moves in 2048 is a surefire way to end the game early, and frankly i didn't want to think of a way to "quantify" or "rank" how good a move is. with imitation learning, each state-action pair is directly labeled, which is pretty great and seemed doable
  • i did find some datasets online of 2048 games, but looking at the stats of those games, they do a lot worse than me. I've been obsessing over 2048 since i was around 10, and my highscore is pictured. As you can see, i am very good at this game. the datasets all suck compared to my own playing. i'm goated. therefore, i think the models will do well if it imitates my play style, and i should train it on data collected off my own games.
  • write about my "journey" here
  • while reading online, the first "method" i came across was using multilayer perceptions.
